scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @finops/web" "npm run start:dev -w @finops/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @finops/shared && npm run build -w @finops/database && npm run build -w @finops/connectors && npm run build -w @finops/api && npm run build -w @finops/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @finops/shared && npm run build -w @finops/database && npm run build -w @finops/connectors && npm run typecheck -w @finops/api && npm run typecheck -w @finops/web
